SELECT #{item.id} as id,
#{item.isEnabled} as is_enabled, #{item.updateBy} as update_by, #{item.updateByName} as update_by_name, #{item.updateTime} as update_time, #{item.isDeleted} as is_deleted

SELECT u.id, u.unit_name, u.unit_type, u.is_enabled
FROM goods_base_unit u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0
AND u.unit_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryUnitReqVO.unitName}, '%')
AND u.is_enabled = #{queryUnitReqVO.isEnabled}
ORDER BY u.create_time desc

SELECT u.id, u.unit_name, u.unit_type, e.id as extend_id, e.unit_extend_name, e.unit_id, e.conversion_ratio, u.is_enabled FROM goods_base_unit u LEFT JOIN goods_base_unit_extend e ON u.id = e.unit_id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.id = #{id}
